park-city.imageAlt: Brown and green A-frame cabin with a wraparound deck, surrounded by pine trees
park-city.style: A postcard A-frame from 1965, tucked into the pines of the gated Pine Mountain community and backing straight onto National Forest — the kind of silhouette guests screenshot before they even book.
park-city.hotTub: Claim the shaded side of the wraparound deck, facing into the trees — it's already built, level, and private from the road.
park-city.distance: The furthest of the three from the Old Town / Deer Valley revenue cluster (~21 mi, 35 min) — the trade-off for a genuine A-frame this far under budget.

park-city.imageAlt: Vaulted wood-ceiling dining nook opening onto a wraparound deck overlooking Rockport Reservoir
park-city.style: A fully remodeled log cabin that opens through a wall of glass onto a wraparound deck suspended over Rockport Reservoir — vaulted tongue-and-groove ceilings, a river-rock fireplace, and a walk-out basement below.
park-city.hotTub: The far end of the deck past the dining nook keeps the same reservoir view as the glass wall, tucked away from the stairs down to the yard.
park-city.distance: Just 9.8 mi (20 min) from the high-revenue cluster — the closest of the three, and the easiest commute for owner visits.

park-city.address: 615 E Cherry Canyon Dr, Coalville, UT 84017
park-city.imageAlt: Long mountain lodge at sunset with a covered deck running the full length of the house
park-city.style: A sprawling lodge on 2.82 horse-friendly acres, wrapped end to end in a covered deck — stone accents, a standing-seam metal roof, and a walk-out basement with room for a future ADU.
park-city.hotTub: Anchor it at the far end of the covered deck, away from the garage entry — dry under the roofline year-round, with the whole valley laid out below.
park-city.distance: About 13.6 mi from the cluster — the listing itself puts it at a 25-minute drive to Park City.

st-george.imageAlt: Stucco desert casita with a covered carport and stone accents in the Harrisburg community
st-george.style: A stand-alone stick-built casita in Harrisburg, not a shared-wall unit — vaulted ceilings, mature trees, and a covered patio framing red-rock views. Listed as a lock-and-leave retreat, and it shows.
st-george.hotTub: The covered patio out back is already shaded and screened by mature landscaping — about as private a couples' soak as this budget buys.
st-george.distance: 5.6 mi from the region's highest-revenue Saint George / Hurricane cluster — close, with real privacy from neighbors on every side.

st-george.imageAlt: Tile-roofed stucco home in Ivins with the red cliffs of Snow Canyon rising behind it
st-george.style: Freshly updated with new quartz counters and fixtures, on a fully fenced and landscaped lot with the red cliffs of Snow Canyon as a backdrop — a quieter, more private corner of the region than the St. George core.
st-george.hotTub: The fenced backyard is already enclosed on all sides — tuck it along the back wall, out of sightline from both neighbors and the street.
st-george.distance: 14.6 mi from the cluster — the furthest of the three, traded for a private, fully fenced yard and the Snow Canyon views.

st-george.imageAlt: Private walled pool courtyard under a shaded pergola with desert mountain views beyond
st-george.style: Fully furnished in Sand Hollow Resort, with a private covered patio enclosed by its own walls — not a shared resort pool, a plunge/swim spa that belongs only to this house — plus a whole-home fire suppression system.
st-george.hotTub: Already there: a private swim spa on the walled, pergola-shaded patio, fully screened from every neighboring unit — about as private as a couples' or group soak gets in a resort community.
st-george.distance: Just 1.7 mi from the high-revenue cluster — the closest of the three, inside a gated resort with pools, a clubhouse, and golf.
